findings.title: Local test:ci red vs CI Tests SUCCESS on same SHA
findings.observation: Prior session: npm run test:ci ~21 failed suites / 415 passed while GitHub CI/CD Tests job SUCCESS on 48bbcffa (run 32525882200).
findings.impact: Masks regressions; undermines gate trust; blocks honest VERIFIED for architecture/gesamtaudit/gate stages.

findings.rootCauseHypothesis: Env/secret/job-matrix/script divergence and/or stale architecture gate regex after refactors.
